summary: Implemented the feature without running tests or committing, per the constraints. Added monai/data/csv_saver.py (CSVSaver) and monai/data/nifti_saver.py (NiftiSaver), added plot_2d_or_3d_image to monai/visualize/img2tensorboard.py, changed write_nifti's default dtype to np.float32, and rewrote the segmentation, classification, and TensorBoard image handlers as thin adapters over the savers and plot function. Renamed output_path to output_dir in two examples and tests/integration_sliding_window.py, and added filename to the classification handler test. Added four new test files: test_csv_saver.py, test_nifti_saver.py, test_handler_segmentation_saver.py, and test_plot_2d_or_3d_image.py. All tests are unverified because they were not executed. Documentation pages were not updated.
